design: Anchor by known own-test BU id and read only mantenedoraId in transaction memory; resolve exact target name with same maintainer using take 2 and id-only projection.
Require unique target BU, one OFICIAL channel, exact current attempt BU/channel/type/generation mapping, one active current providerResourceIdentity, and generation-scoped credential count.
Use RepeatableRead and SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY; no Nest bootstrap, resolver, provider request, or writes.

Aggregate lifetime IN/OUT/status groups and conversations for the selected identity; aggregate BU OFICIAL meta.webhook count/min/max without selecting/filtering payload and mark identity attribution unavailable.

Output only internal UUIDs, safe states, generation/epoch/verification/lease/receipt flags, counts, and fixed failure enums; never project maintainer id, BU name, phone, provider external ID, credentials, session or payload.
Unknown free-form state/stage values map to fixed UNKNOWN; ids/date/integer/boolean structures validate before projection.

cases: multiple target BU matches fail closed
current attempt scope drift fails closed
zero current-generation credential count remains explicit false
unknown DB strings sanitize to UNKNOWN and private canaries are absent
aggregate direction/status projection and invalid-status rejection
